title: Issue or not
symptom: After starting a new Libre sensor and calibrating it, the old sensor's data points were pushed below the zero line on the timeline instead of remaining. Additionally, the user sometimes gets different readings on the phone and on the watch, with the phone showing the plugin value and the watch showing the xDrip calibrated value.
evidence_quote: Should'nt it be so that if you stop the old sensor and start a new one the old value should stay
